request: Build a small Jac web app for planning a spoken local weekly brief. Show the Monday that anchors the current brief week and a readable week label. Let a visitor choose a date to preview its brief week and day index. Weekdays belong to their current Monday; weekend dates belong to the upcoming Monday. Keep the date logic in a reusable service and make the page usable without an AI key.
acceptance: The date service exposes brief_monday, brief_day_index, and brief_week_label with the planned signatures.
Weekdays use their current Monday; weekends use the upcoming Monday and have negative day indices relative to it.
The home page renders and a visitor can select a date to see its week label and day index.
constraints: Use Jac 0.34.27 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the date logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.
